description: Na₂H₄Te₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.61 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.50 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.17 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms to form edge-sharing ONa₂Te₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Te atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
